decisions.reason: The individual EARsleeve builds directly on the firm's core earmold know-how, so it can absorb fitter feedback and keep refining the product within its hearing-care system.
The vacuum thermoforming unit is a natural extension of the firm's dental materials and equipment workflow, where in-house R&D and long experience let it interpret results and improve the device.

The orthopedic shoe last is distant from the firm's established knowledge base, which makes early results harder to interpret, but its own page and the firm's digital manufacturing and materials capabilities justify continued learning for now.
The post-curing unit complements the firm's digital dental and 3D-printing materials workflow, so existing knowledge lets the firm assimilate feedback and integrate it into its system offer.
